criteria.requirement: Extend validated Settings.load_file with format=None|json|toml|yaml and thread it into settings_loader. Explicit mode overrides suffix discovery and skips Python-module guessing, using whitelisted existing readers through real BaseLoader with actual file paths/source metadata, environment/key filtering, merge/validation/hooks contracts. Reject unknown or disabled core loaders; syntax errors stay visible under existing semantics. Default extension discovery remains unchanged; do not copy files to fake suffixes, import arbitrary format strings or treat a filename as serialized config text.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
